question: What is the employee's annual salary?

goal_plan.reasoning: The query asks for the annual salary of an employee, but it does not specify which employee. Without a name, role, or organization, there is no way to identify a specific individual. This makes the query incomplete and unanswerable as-is. However, since the task is to plan a search strategy, we must assume the user intends to refer to a specific employee, possibly one previously mentioned in context. Since no such context is provided, the only possible action is to identify the employee first. Therefore, the first and only sub-goal is to determine the identity of the employee in question.

The minimum amount that may be accelerated is $5,000.
The maximum amount that may be accelerated is $250,000.
The accelerated amount will be reduced by an actuarial discount.

hop_events.from_node: death benefit (Insurance payout upon death)

candidates.target: If an individual is diagnosed with a terminal illness with a life expectancy of 12 months or less, they may request acceleration of up to 75% of their death benefit.
Any amount accelerated reduces the death benefit payable to beneficiaries.
If no beneficiary survives the individual, benefits will be paid to the individual's estate.
If multiple beneficiaries are named, benefits are divided equally unless specific percentages are specified.

hop_events.from_node: beneficiary (Recipient of death benefit)

candidates.target: If multiple beneficiaries are named, benefits are divided equally unless specified percentages are provided.
Beneficiaries should notify Alliance Group Benefits immediately upon the death of the insured employee.
Proof of beneficiary identity is required to file a claim.
Any amount accelerated reduces the death benefit payable to beneficiaries.
If death occurs by suicide within 12 months of the coverage effective date, no death benefit will be paid.

hop_events.from_node: death benefit (Insurance payout upon death)

candidates.target: If an individual is diagnosed with a terminal illness with a life expectancy of 12 months or less, they may request acceleration of up to 75% of their death benefit.
Any amount accelerated reduces the death benefit payable to beneficiaries.
If death occurs by suicide within 12 months of the coverage effective date, no death benefit will be paid.
If no beneficiary survives the individual, benefits will be paid to the individual's estate.

hop_events.from_node: 31 days (Deadline for conversion or portability application)

candidates.target: The individual must apply for conversion within 31 days of termination of group coverage.

hop_events.from_node: individual whole life policy (Converted insurance policy)

candidates.target: If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability.
The conversion policy will be issued at standard premium rates for the individual policy.
The maximum amount for the conversion policy is the lesser of the group coverage amount or $200,000.
No medical exam is required for conversion to an individual whole life policy.
No health questions are required for conversion to an individual whole life policy.
If an individual leaves employment, they may port their coverage by continuing it as an individual policy.
Ported coverage continues at the same amount the individual had under the group policy.
Premium rates for ported coverage will be age-banded group rates.
Premiums for ported coverage are payable directly to the insurance company.
Evidence of insurability is not required for portability.

hop_events.from_node: group coverage (Insurance policy type)

candidates.target: If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability.
The maximum amount for the conversion policy is the lesser of the group coverage amount or $200,000.
Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions.

hop_events.from_node: individual whole life policy (Converted insurance policy)

candidates.target: If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability.
The conversion policy will be issued at the individual's attained age at conversion.
The conversion policy will be issued at standard premium rates for the individual policy.
The maximum amount for the conversion policy is the lesser of the group coverage amount or $200,000.
No medical exam is required for conversion to an individual whole life policy.
No health questions are required for conversion to an individual whole life policy.
If an individual leaves employment, they may port their coverage by continuing it as an individual policy.
Premium rates for ported coverage will be age-banded group rates.
Premiums for ported coverage are payable directly to the insurance company.
Evidence of insurability is not required for portability.
